name: Rizuhble's Bedtime Story Paige
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bookwyrm T1, Captivating Read T2, Rallying Charge T1.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 11200 souls (~11.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bookwyrm (1 to 2).

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 13 to Bookwyrm's damage (1.30x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-20,000 (levels 12-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Plot Armor T3, Captivating Read T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Captivating Read, damage) grows from 133 to 234. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Rescue Beam.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Captivating Read: widens its range.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 23.4 to Bookwyrm's damage (1.30x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Plot Armor: takes 18% off its 28s base cooldown.

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Healing Rite (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Drop it on whoever dives your team, then throw your 3 on them.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Captivating Read: its duration-scaled parts (debuff duration 6s, immobilize duration 2s) get +22%.
items.legacy_note: On Captivating Read. It makes the root last longer.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bookwyrm (2 to 3). Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-48,000 (levels 25-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rallying Charge T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Captivating Read, damage) grows from 234 to 351.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 230s; 20% off is 46s per full rotation.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Rallying Charge knight position spread (1.8m), Bookwyrm dragon travel range (20m), Captivating Read radius (9.5m). Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Rallying Charge duration (13s), Rallying Charge buff duration (9s), Rallying Charge stun duration (1.5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 39 to Bookwyrm's damage (1.30x scaling).

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Curse their carry as your team jumps them.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Rallying Charge deals damage (damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Knockdown? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
sections.desc: Dying after Knockdown? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Plot Armor: resets its 28s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Opening Rounds: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Plot Armor. Sell Opening Rounds for this.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 230s of base cooldown across your kit, 165s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
